strengths: Immediate visual hook featuring absurd physical balance and heavy obstacle gag
Seamless transition into King Robert trapped under a heavy stone hazard
Clear call-to-action for match-3 gameplay to break the stone and save the King
concerns: Original trend depends heavily on Turkish spoken proverb dialogue which must be ignored in favor of pure visual comedy
adaptation_idea: King Robert humorously balances a massive falling castle stone on his head while crying out for help. Players match hammer and stone tiles in gameplay to shatter the heavy boulder before he collapses.
